title: Stone2 Solo #29 (석재 솔로 · turquoise · 체형 BBW bombshell · 인종 ebony · 메이크업 립온리 블랙 5단계 · 극한 · 배경 아트리움 · 힐 숫자 없음 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, mid 50s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, half-up half-down deep burgundy hair — full body polished turquoise fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING sky-blue turquoise surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID dark brown matrix webbing running through every section, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: back three-quarter turned, face over shoulder direct eye contact, bubble butt projected backward — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals carved from the same turquoise, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, carved from the same turquoise with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT carved — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: a clean bare face with natural eyes, thick opaque lacquer-glossy jet-black lips overlined fuller than natural, dominating the whole face.

Background: a bright airy glass-roofed atrium with a pale polished floor, a wide staircase with standard-height steps and tall potted trees, filled with soft white daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
